# Marchand Wealth

> Ethan Marchand is an independent Insurance & Wealth Advisor based in Sherwood Park, Alberta, serving individuals, families, and business owners across Alberta with tax-efficient insurance and wealth planning.

Marchand Wealth (legal name: Marchand Financial Solutions Inc.) provides corporate and personal life insurance, critical illness and disability insurance, estate planning, business succession and buy-sell agreement funding, and retirement/tax planning including TFSA and RRSP strategy. Ethan is an independent advisor, not tied to a single insurance carrier's product lineup. Before insurance and wealth advisory, he spent 10 years as a realtor (2015-2025) and has traded stocks, bonds, and options since 2015.

## Pages

- [Home](https://marchandwealth.ca/): Overview of services, plus an FAQ on corporate-owned life insurance, estate planning, buy-sell agreements, and business succession for Alberta business owners.
- [Life Insurance Quote](https://marchandwealth.ca/life-insurance-quote.html): Free instant life insurance quote comparison tool (Compulife) showing real-time term and permanent life insurance rates from major Canadian insurers. Includes an FAQ on health class, term vs. permanent coverage, and how quotes work.
- [TFSA Calculator](https://marchandwealth.ca/tfsa-calculator.html): Free interactive Canadian TFSA calculator. Takes a user's age, current balance, contributions to date, and either a planned monthly contribution or a "keep me maxed out" toggle, then estimates available contribution room, shows whether that pace catches up (and exactly when, with a year-by-year payment schedule), and projects the account's tax-free growth and retirement income. Includes an FAQ on TFSA contribution limits and rules.
- [Financial Plan](https://marchandwealth.ca/needs-analysis.html): Simplified financial plan for life insurance need, disability and critical illness amounts, and the retirement savings path. Entries stay in the browser tab and are not sent to a server. Print the plan if a copy needs to be kept.
- [Insights](https://marchandwealth.ca/insights.html): Articles on tax, insurance, and retirement planning, including TFSA retirement strategy, CRA tax instalment interest, corporate-owned life insurance and the Capital Dividend Account, life insurance insurability and convertibility, whether a financial advisor is worth the cost, and the pay-yourself-first savings habit.
- [Contact](https://marchandwealth.ca/contact.html): Contact form and direct phone/email to reach Ethan Marchand.
- [Schedule](https://marchandwealth.ca/schedule.html): Book a free consultation.
